    inc rsi
    add rdi, 8           ; next digit
    dec r9
    jnz .Lascii_0
    mov r8, rdx          ; save digit count
    mov rax, 1           ; sys_write
    mov rdi, 1           ; stdout
    lea rsi, [rsp]       ; buffer
    syscall
    lea rsp, [rsp+r8]    ; deallocate buffer
    lea rsp, [rsp+r8*8]  ; deallocate digit pushes
    ; RUNTIME: stdout_put_nl
    mov rax, 1     ; sys_write
    mov rdi, 1     ; stdout
    lea rsi, [newline]
    mov rdx, 1
    syscall
    pop rcx         ; restore rcx
    mov rdi, rbx    ; exit code
    mov rax, 60     ; sys_exit
    syscall
